answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial, committing its identity within a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. The network verifies this evidence and instantly slashes collateral, resisting Sybil identities across dawn, nebula, and trellis phases.
